AgaKulche, a brand of Agabullion, is renowned in the gold industry for providing cutting-edge precious metal investment solutions through advanced technologies and digital platforms.
AgaBullion has unparalleled expertise and experience across the entire precious metals supply chain, from local to global markets. This includes financial institutions, central banks, government agencies, trading houses, well-delivery certified refineries, wholesale and retail jewelers, investors and more. They are committed to delivering business excellence, thought leadership, innovation and compliance with globally accepted best practices
The AGA KULCHE Gold Bar is a premium bullion product, offering outstanding purity and exceptional craftsmanship in a convenient and valuable form.
Produced by AGA KULCHE, in collaboration with Aleks Metal Rafineri, this 2.5 gram gold bar is a popular choice among collectors and investors seeking high-quality 24-karat gold bullion.
Bar Highlights:
Mint Facility: AGA KULCHE and Aleks Metal Rafineri
Purity: 99.99% gold minimum (24 karat)
Metal Weight: 2.5 grams (.0804 troy ounces)
Features the name “Aga Kulche,” “2.5g Fine Gold,” “999.9,” and a unique serial number on the obverse.
Displays the  logo, representing quality and authenticity on the reverse.
